values.description: Raw access token from the last Register/Login response. Filled automatically by their test scripts — set by hand only if you already have one.
"Bearer " + fetch_token — the exact value every authenticated request sends as the Authorization header. Filled automatically alongside fetch_token.
The authenticated user's id, as returned by Register/Login. Filled automatically.

The six-digit code from Identity > Verification > Request verification code. Filled automatically only against a local run, which echoes it instead of sending mail; anywhere else, type what arrived in the inbox.
The one-time ticket Confirm verification code hands back, spent by Register. Filled automatically.
The token out of the emailed reset link — the part after `?token=`. Set by hand: nothing can fill this automatically, which is exactly what makes it proof that you can read the address.

The account a request names in its body rather than its path — Financial > Enter transfer leg, which requires one. Filled automatically by Open account; set by hand to point at an account you already have (its id is in List accounts).
